_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

name.description: Name of the recipe; used as its display value in other collections

equipmentName.description: Display value of equipmentId, copied from u_mes_mast_equipment.name

itemName.description: Display value of itemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

operationName.description: Display value of operationId, copied from u_mes_prod_operation.name

effectiveFrom.description: Effective from. Date field: calendar date only, stored as 00:00:00 of that day in local plant time (IST) with the +0000 suffix

effectiveTo.description: Effective to. Date field: calendar date only, stored as 00:00:00 of that day in local plant time (IST) with the +0000 suffix

engineeringChangeName.description: Display value of engineeringChangeId, copied from u_mes_prod_engineeringChange.title

checksum.description: Checksum of the parameter set used to detect an unapproved change at the controller

approvedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'approved'

approvedBy.description: Display name of the user in approvedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

approvedAt.description: Date and time when the record was approved. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

lastDownloadedAt.description: Last downloaded date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

previousVersionRecipeId.description: Reference to u_mes_prod_recipe._id: previous version recipe

previousVersionRecipeName.description: Display value of previousVersionRecipeId, copied from u_mes_prod_recipe.name

changeReasonText.description: Reason for the change from the previous version

releasedAt.description: Time the version was released for production

isGoldenRecipe.description: True when the version is the approved golden recipe for its variant and machine

goldenDesignatedAt.description: Time the version was designated golden recipe

goldenDesignatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'golden designated'

goldenDesignatedBy.description: Display name of the user in goldenDesignatedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

origin.description: Where the parameter set came from

analyticsModelName.description: Display value of analyticsModelId, copied from u_mes_syst_analyticsModel.name

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
